name: Matching Networks
tagline: Bidirectional-LSTM contextualized support features + attention-LSTM query encoder; classify by cosine soft attention.
formula: $$\hat y_q = \sum_{i=1}^{N_s} a(\hat q, \hat s_i)\, y_i,\quad a(\hat q, \hat s_i) = \mathrm{softmax}_i\!\left(\hat q\cdot \frac{\hat s_i}{\lVert\hat s_i\rVert}\right);\quad \mathcal{L} = \mathrm{NLL}(\log\hat y, y)$$

key_hyperparams.name: LR_OVERRIDE
key_hyperparams.role: needed for LSTM stability vs default SGD@1e-2

diff_from_baseline: Vinyals, Blundell, Lillicrap, Kavukcuoglu & Wierstra 2016 (NeurIPS). First neural-attention few-shot classifier: support encoded by BiLSTM (FCE), query attends to support via LSTM cell, label predicted by soft-attention vote.

name: Prototypical Networks
tagline: Mean support feature per class as prototype; classify queries by negative squared Euclidean distance.
diff_from_baseline: Snell, Swersky & Zemel 2017 (NeurIPS). Canonical metric-based few-shot baseline: class prototype = mean support embedding; query labeled by nearest prototype under squared Euclidean distance. Default reference for nearly every few-shot study.

name: Relation Networks
tagline: Concatenate query/prototype feature maps; learn a small CNN relation module that scores each pair.

key_hyperparams.name: inner_channels
key_hyperparams.role: MLP head width inside relation module

key_hyperparams.name: use_pooling
key_hyperparams.role: needs feature maps for conv relation

diff_from_baseline: Sung et al. 2018 (CVPR). Replaces fixed metric (cosine/Euclidean) with a learned relation network producing relation scores in [0,1]; trained with MSE against one-hot. Standard learned-metric few-shot baseline.
